annotations.title: Chronological Event Timeline Compiler & Milestone Synthesizer

description: Synthesizes chronological milestone timelines from search results, news archives, and historical documents. Use when reconstructing historical events, tracking company histories, or mapping regulatory progression; for tracking real-time breaking news in the past 24 hours, use analyze_news_recency instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'event_corpus' ('timeline_resolution' defaults to 'chronological_milestones'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

ascending_order.description: Whether to sort timeline from oldest to newest (true) or reverse chronological (false).

event_corpus.description: Unstructured text corpus containing dated events, news reports, or historical accounts.

timeline_resolution.description: Temporal event grouping: chronological milestones, daily chronicle, or weekly epochs.

name: summarize_temporal_timeline

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for summarize_temporal_timeline.

date_range.description: Start date and end date spanning the compiled chronological timeline.

timeline_events.description: Ordered sequence of date-stamped milestone entries with descriptions.

turning_points.description: Key pivot points or inflection events identified in the historical narrative.
